identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King. Zoom In. Negative Space. Contrast.
identity.mission: Create a 'Mission Control' dashboard for high-volume B2B product sync. Avoid generic SaaS templates. Prioritize data density, clarity, and speed.

rules: Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all IDs, SKUs, API Keys, Logs, and Tabular Data.
Use 'Manrope' for UI labels, descriptions, and buttons.
Use tabular-nums class for all numeric data in tables.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(59,130,246,0.5)] border border-blue-400/20

inputs.default: bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-800 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 rounded-none placeholder:text-zinc-600 text-sm font-mono

cards.style: bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-800 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-sm hover:border-zinc-700 transition-colors
cards.header: p-4 border-b border-zinc-800/50 flex flex-row items-center justify-between

tables.header: bg-zinc-900/80 text-zinc-400 text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-zinc-800

badges.default: rounded-none px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono border

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise texture on the main background to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px borders everywhere. Avoid heavy shadows. Depth is created by border contrast, not shadow.
visual_enhancers.accents: Use 'Tracing Beam' effect for active sync jobs or selected items.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use minimalist ASCII art or technical SVG illustrations for empty states. No playful cartoons.

icons.instructions: Use Lucide icons for all standard UI elements. Use simple, recognizable shapes.

anti_ai_rules: No rounded corners > 8px (use rounded-sm or rounded-none).
accessibility: Ensure contrast ratio > 4.5:1 for normal text.
Use aria-labels for all icon-only buttons.
Focus states must be highly visible (ring-2 ring-blue-500).
testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (kebab-case).
technical: Do not use native HTML date pickers or selects; use Shadcn equivalents.

implementation_plan.step_1: Install fonts (Chivo, Manrope, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts in index.css.
implementation_plan.step_2: Update tailwind.config.js with new font families and color palette.
implementation_plan.step_3: Customize Shadcn components (Button, Card, Input, Table) to match the 'Tactical' flat design.
implementation_plan.step_4: Build Layout Shell (Sidebar, Header, Main Content Area).
implementation_plan.step_5: Implement Dashboard Overview with dense stats.
implementation_plan.step_6: Implement Product Catalog with virtualized list/grid for performance.
implementation_plan.step_7: Implement Sync Management with real-time log viewer.
